description:
TasksBoard is a simple, board-style to-do app that keeps all your daily tasks in one place. Create multiple lists side by side - like Work, Personal, Groceries, or any project you're juggling - and see everything at a glance on a clean, distraction-free board.

Add tasks in seconds, break them down with subtasks, set due dates, and add notes for the details you don't want to forget. Drag and drop to reorder or move tasks between lists as your priorities shift. Check things off and enjoy watching your board clear.

Your tasks stay in sync across all your devices, so your list is always up to date whether you're at your desk or on the go. You can also share lists with family, roommates, or teammates to plan and get things done together in real time.

Whether you're organizing your workday, planning a trip, or managing a household, TasksBoard gives you a focused, visual way to stay on top of everything that matters.
